disk_hygiene_check.title: disk-hygiene-check
disk_hygiene_check.content: At the end of every work session or turn (especially after builds/tests/subagent work), run a disk check: `df -h` on the data volume and `du -sh target` in the repo. If free space is below ~20 GiB or build artifacts are bloated, auto-clean WITHOUT asking: remove target/debug/incremental, run `cargo clean -p <unneeded crates>`, prune old target/debug artifacts, and report what was freed. Never delete source, git history, or user data. This is a standing user preference ('you should always do it... add a simple check at end and auto do so').

convex_backend_feature_backlog_user_defe.title: convex-backend feature backlog (user-deferred items)
convex_backend_feature_backlog_user_defe.content: In the convex-backend repo, the user deferred these features to LATER (do not start without being asked): 1) durable objects as a DATABASE-BACKED Convex feature in Cloudflare Durable Objects style (named objects, persisted state, alarms/timers); 2) SurrealDB newest 3.0 integration (alt transactional backend or data-source connector); 3) Turso/libsql support (similar to sqlite). ACTIVE focus (current): WASM backend-function guest implementations + examples for Rust, Go, C/C++, Dart, Kotlin in crates/wasm_runner (docs/wasm.md tracks status).
